contributions.summary: A TrueSkill-style team rating with two skill updates under one display number.
A SARIMAX forecast plus an Inverse-Gamma standard-deviation layer.
A random forest for new events, with MAE printed and no forest equation.
A residual screen and an LR-SCAD medal regression with no printed penalty.

dependency_graph.summary: The SARIMAX forecast takes the TrueSkill yearly performance.
The forest takes the 2028 traditional-event predictions as inputs.
The interval table adds both event classes and swaps extremes.
The residual screen takes event performance from the rating model.

assumptions.summary: Performance in different sports does not affect each other.
Athletes without medals stand in for fourth-place finishers.
Each country takes at most one medal per event.
Dissolved states are cut at the dissolution timestamp.
Russian participation in 2028 is excluded, consistent with IOC sanctions.
